description: 3D permeable-surface FW-H (U 10) around a sphere in prescribed surge oscillation (6DOF motion file X 240, X 11 2 0 0 0 0 0), closed tank, single phase, sinh-stretched grid, 4 MPI ranks, N40=4 (loop_cfd). Observers near the box and outside the domain, image observers across z = 1.5 (U 40/41). Coarse version of Regression/validation/fwh 01.
covers: acoustics_fwh: box snapped to grid nodes, panels split over ranks, staggered sampling
fwh_permeable kernel: advanced time, image observers
